svg.title: Timeline of the continued run, attempts 101 to 250, and the agents that made them
svg.desc: Claude Code agents, all on Claude Opus 5.5, from November 15 to 16, 2026 (UTC): 38 rounds of four builders (two in the last) and an integrator, one pull request each (#97 to #134), and the output tokens of each pull request. Drawn for this repo from the session's transcripts.
svg.text: 150 more attempts, 188 agents, one model: Claude Opus 5.5
Each bar is one agent, from its first message to its last. Times in UTC, November 15 to 16, 2026.
Output tokens per pull request (all of its agents)
Builder D, round 12 and odd rounds: the app with the fewest attempts
Builder D, even rounds 14 to 48: a refactor of the site's code
Rounds 12 to 48 had four builders and an integrator, one pull request each (#97 to #133); round 49 had two builders, C and D (#134).
Builders A, B, C: a game or toy app, a tool or music app, and the site, its runtime and the shim. Builders committed locally; the integrator merged and opened the pull request.
Not drawn: the orchestrator, which ran the whole session and started every agent, and the agent that made the final history pull request.
